raw_response:
Answer: A
Reason: The chest radiograph shows a complete white-out of the right hemithorax with a contralateral (leftward) mediastinal shift, which is the classic presentation of a massive pleural effusion pushing structures away from the affected side. Other causes of white-out like atelectasis would cause an ipsilateral shift, while pneumonia typically does not cause significant mediastinal displacement.
